context: Prospective test of the thin-book excursion mechanism: evaluating whether 6-hour C3 forecasts next-hour forced liquidation volume beyond baseline and whether realized liquidation volume mediates C3 excursion forecasting gain.
fallback_protocol: Prospective-in-time test on public daily archive files from data.binance.vision for dates strictly after the registration push, per Rule 5 (Binance futures live websocket blocked under US jurisdiction, HTTP 451).
hypotheses: P1: Six-hour C3 forecasts next-hour liquidation volume beyond the volatility, impact and lagged-liquidation baseline.
P2: Adding realized next-hour liquidation volume removes at least 50% of C3's excursion forecasting gain.

pass_rules.P1: Clark-West one-sided p < 0.05 and date-block bootstrap 95% CI for Delta R^2 excluding zero
pass_rules.P2: Mediation share >= 50% with bootstrap 95% CI above zero

opening_rule: Commit and push specification to origin/main alone; unlock counter starts at 0 and increments to 1 upon opening; evaluate once on prospective archive files recorded after the registration commit timestamp.
